51)༄༅/khang nang bla ma bkra shis phun tshogs kyi sprul sku la ched du brjod pas go na rna ba'i bu ram ma go btang snyoms 'jog na chog pa bzhugs/'phrin las ba

tei:div.tei:p: khang nang bla ma bkra shis phun tshogs kyi sprul sku la ched du brjod pas go na rna ba'i bu ram ma go btang snyoms 'jog na chog pa bzhugs/ 'phrin las bye ba'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan// phun tshogs yon tan rgya mtsho gsal mdzad pa// rdo rje 'dzin dbang dpal ldan bla ma de// srid dang zhi ba yongs kyi gtsug na mtho// snga 'gyur bka' gter rgyud dang sgrub sde yi// cho ga phyag bzhes rig 'dzin zhal gyi lung*// dbyangs rol la sogs phra zhing phra ba yang*// zhib par spel ba'i bka' drin mkha' dang mnyam// lta dgongs rtogs pa rab kyi phul du phyin// sku tshe gcig la sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// lugs gnyis bstan la sman pa'i phrin las bskyangs// bshes gnyen khyod 'drar mtshungs zla dka' ba tsam// mgon des bstan pa 'di la thugs bskyed kyis// slar yang srid pa sa yi khyod du bzung*// chos kyi nyi mas dag pa'i gzigs pas bstan// sprul pa'i rol gar bshad sgrub rgya mtsho lags// 'di nas gnas 'dir spun dang grogs ltar 'grogs// pha ma yul gru gcig las chad pas na// stong sde'i sngon 52)yang rang cag ma mthun than// bya ba las kyis zhabs 'degs dka' na yang*// bsam pa'i sems kyi 'di las mthun thabs med// phan pa'i gdam ngag zer ba dka' na yang*// brtse ba'i sems kyis gros mol 'di la gson// deng sang snod bcud log par snang ba'i dus// ji ltar byas kyang red thabs gtan nas med// nor med tshe na kun gyi than du brtsi// nor dang ldan na kun gyis mi dga' blta// mthun 'jug ma byas kun gyi blor mi 'bab// mthun 'jug byas na zad pa'i pha mtha' med// de bas ji ltar byas kyang phan med pas// da ni ngang tshul sba ba'i dus la bab// 'jig rten 'di na bden gtam bshad pa'i yul// yun du btsal yang mi rnyed thag chod pas// rang gi sems la dran pa'i gtam de ni// mchog dman 'brel 'dris su la ma smra zhig

/bzang ngan stod smad gang du mi 'gro ba'i// lung ma bstan gyi gtam de kun la shod// 'jig rten 'di na bden gtam bshad mi ni// su yang med phyir brag ca'i sgra bzhin du// bshad pa'i gtam ni 53)nye ring su yin kyang*// bla ma ma gtogs gzhan gyi ngag ma nyan// chos dang 'jig rten bya ba gang mang yang*// bzang ngan cir 'gyur sngon du legs par dpyad// dpyad pa thong nas rang thag rang gis bcad// dri ba'i blo de nam yang ma byed cig yul 'dir 'khod pa'i mchog dman gang la yang*// kun nas phan sems nyag gcig 'chang ba las// nye ring phyogs lhung bzung ba gnas ma yin// gshin po'i rgyu rdzas phra zhing phra na yang*// dge ba'i phyogs su ci 'gyur rgyun du rol// phyi ma'i rnam smin lan chags bda' 'ded de// bsam zhing bsam zhing skrag pa snying nas skye// 'jig rten bya ba che phra gang la yang*// che bzhag chung bskyur bya rgyu 'di ma gtogs// rang res sangs rgyas rjes 'jug yin pa la// 'jig rten bya ba rgyal bas gnang ba med// chos kyi phyogs nas yon tan rta phos nyo// skyon dang nyes pa khab rtses bsal dgos kyang*// rang re'i bya ba 'di las gzhan ma yin// de phyir nyin gcig stong 'dug ma song bar// dge bar brtson dang de las lhag ci yod// 'on kyang ltar snang dge bar snang na yang*// rtsa ba 54)bsam pa 'di la rag las pas// ja tshe re bzhin bsam pa 'di la dpyod// bsam pa kun slong rnam dag med pa yi// dge sbyor de ni yul phud rjes 'don gyis// bsam pa byang chub sems dang ldan dus der// dge sbyor phra yang nan tan lhur len gyis// 'don yus sgrub yus sdug yus med pa yi// 'don pa des ni bton go chod pa yin// bskyed dang rdzogs dang rdzogs pa chen po rnams// nyams len gang yod lag tu lon nges gyis// nam mkha' lha yi 'khor lor ma gyur bar// bskyed rim bsgom dgos sgom yus bshad sa med// rtsa rlung thig le las su ma rung bar// rdzogs rim bsgom dgos zhag grangs zla grangs med// nyin mtshan 'od gsal 'khor lor ma gyur bar// rdzogs chen sgom dgos stong skad bshad sa med// byang chub sems 'di rgyud la ma skyes bar// sems bskyed bsgom dgos yod mdog 'dis mi phan// tshe 'dir zhen pa gting nas ma ldog bar// blo sbyong sgom dgos kha yag bshad mi phan// lha mi'i bde skyid dug ltar ma mthong bar// nges 'byung

55) sgom dgos sgom yus bshad sa med// dam pa'i chos 'di rgyud la sbyor sbyor dang*// 'dres pa'i rtags ni skor cig nges par 'byung*// de yi bar du 'bad 'bungs chos la thon// dge ba bya ba dran pa'i dus nas rtsoms// mi dge dran na de ma thag tu spongs// dam chos gsha' ma zhig ni mdzad par zhu// ltar snang chos pa lta bur snang na yang*// don du rang rgyud yar skyed med pa yi// dge sbyor de lad ni zhe kha log /nga ni sngon chad de 'dra'i dbang du song*/ khyed kyang nga yi rjes su ma slob par// grub brnyes rig 'dzin bye ba gshegs shul la// de ring nyid nas byon pa'i dus la bab// kha bshad don la med pa'i ne tso des/ don med 'chal gtam shog gu gren phyir bris// pad+ma ma ṇi'i gsung dge'o// 56)
